summary.en: Pastel candy colours: high lightness, clear but never harsh saturation, and a bias toward pink, mint and cream. Reads as sweet, soft and approachable.
summary.cn: 粉彩糖果色：明度高、饱和度清亮而不刺眼，色相偏向粉、薄荷与奶油。读起来甜、软、亲近。

bestFor.en: Consumer apps, food and drink, children's products, seasonal campaigns, onboarding and empty states
bestFor.cn: 消费级应用、餐饮、童品、季节性活动、引导页与空状态

avoidFor.en: Financial dashboards, dense data tables, legal or medical information, anything where numbers must be read fast
avoidFor.cn: 金融看板、密集数据表、法律或医疗信息，以及任何要求快速读数的场景

hue.en: pink, mint, cream, sky — warm and cool in balance
hue.cn: 粉、薄荷、奶油、天蓝——冷暖相济

summary.en: Grey-toned muted colours: every hue is pulled toward neutral, so nothing shouts. Reads as quiet, studied and tactile.
summary.cn: 带灰的克制色：每个色相都被拉向中性，谁也不出声。读起来安静、耐看、有手感。

bestFor.en: Editorial layouts, gallery and portfolio sites, lifestyle brands, subtle dashboards, long-form reading
bestFor.cn: 编辑式排版、作品集与画廊、生活方式品牌、克制的看板、长文阅读

avoidFor.en: Interfaces that need one obvious action, or audiences that expect vivid energy
avoidFor.cn: 需要唯一显性动作的界面，或期待鲜艳活力的受众

hue.en: sage, clay, mist blue, dust — all mixed with grey
hue.cn: 鼠尾草、陶土、雾蓝、藕荷——都掺了灰

summary.en: A near-monochrome system: paper, black, a ladder of greys, and exactly one signal colour. The layout does the work, not the palette.
summary.cn: 近乎单色的系统：纸、白黑、一条灰阶，再加恰好一个信号色。做功的是版式，不是颜色。

bestFor.en: Editorial and publishing, documentation, architecture and design studios, data reporting, ticketing and wayfinding
bestFor.cn: 出版与编辑、文档、建筑与设计事务所、数据报告、票务与导视

avoidFor.en: Brands that need warmth or playfulness, and products aimed at children
avoidFor.cn: 需要温度或趣味的品牌，以及面向儿童的产品

hue.en: achromatic by design — the one chromatic member is the signal colour
hue.cn: 刻意无色相——唯一有彩色的成员是信号色

summary.en: Cool, pale and airy: near-white surfaces, glacial blues, and a few warm accents used sparingly to keep it from going cold.
summary.cn: 冷、浅、通透：近白的底、冰川般的蓝，再点缀少量暖色，免得发冷。

bestFor.en: SaaS and developer tools, healthcare, travel and hospitality, portfolios, documentation
bestFor.cn: SaaS 与开发者工具、医疗、旅行与酒店、作品集、文档站

avoidFor.en: Brands that need warmth or urgency, and dense dashboards where pale colours wash out
avoidFor.cn: 需要温度或紧迫感的品牌，以及浅色会糊掉的密集看板

hue.en: blue-grey and spruce, with terracotta and mustard as warm counterweights
hue.cn: 蓝灰与云杉，配陶土橘与芥末作暖色平衡

summary.en: Earth-derived colours with visible texture: lime plaster, sand, clay, moss and bark. Low chroma, warm bias, nothing polished.
summary.cn: 取自泥土的颜色，带着材质的纹理：石灰墙、沙、陶土、苔与树皮。低彩度、偏暖、不抛光。

bestFor.en: Furniture and interiors, craft and handmade goods, food brands, wellness, slow-living publications
bestFor.cn: 家具与室内、手作与手工品、食品品牌、健康生活、慢生活刊物

avoidFor.en: Products that need to look new, technical, or fast-moving
avoidFor.cn: 需要显得崭新、技术或高速的产品

hue.en: warm earth — clay, bark, moss, forest

summary.en: High-chroma primaries and hot pink on black and white, with squiggles, grids and clashing geometry. Loud on purpose.
summary.cn: 高彩度的原色与亮粉，压在黑白之上，再加波浪线、网格和撞色几何。就是要吵。

bestFor.en: Youth brands, events and music, tech that wants to look like a launch, illustration and editorial accents
bestFor.cn: 年轻品牌、活动与音乐、想要「刚发布」感的产品、插画与编辑点缀

avoidFor.en: Trust-heavy domains such as finance, healthcare, government and enterprise procurement
avoidFor.cn: 强调可信度的领域：金融、医疗、政务与企业采购

hue.en: pink, orange, yellow, turquoise, blue, violet — deliberately unbalanced
hue.cn: 粉、橙、黄、青绿、蓝、紫——刻意不均衡

summary.en: A near-black canvas lit by fluorescent accents: cyan, magenta, acid lime. The colours glow because everything around them stays dark.
summary.cn: 近黑的底布上点亮荧光强调色：青、品红、荧光酸绿。之所以发光，是因为四周够黑。

bestFor.en: Nightlife, music and gaming, developer tools that want an edge, portfolio and landing pages, terminal-adjacent products
bestFor.cn: 夜生活、音乐与游戏、要有锋芒的开发者工具、作品集与落地页、终端类产品

avoidFor.en: Reading-heavy content, forms, printing, and anyone who needs daylight clarity
avoidFor.cn: 长文阅读、表单、打印，以及任何需要日光下清晰度的场景

hue.en: cyan, magenta, acid lime, violet, amber — on a black ground
hue.cn: 青、品红、荧光绿、紫、琥珀——压黑底
